x-e-e1-01.title: Hel ficillada aan waafaqsanayn ogeysiiska barkadda
x-e-e1-01.topic: Salaan gaaban, ogeysiisyo, iyo sawirro lagu sawiray erayo
x-e-e1-01.goal: Waafaji saddexda xeer ee ogeysiiska xaaladda qof kasta, dooro kiisaska jebinaya xeerarka, oo sababta Ingiriis ku sheeg.
x-e-e1-01.material:
Ogeysiiska albaabka barkadda (waxaa lagu qoray erayo oo keliya, sawir la'aan):

Pool Rules
1. No running.
2. Swim caps on, please.
3. Under 8? Come with a grown-up.

(grown-up = an adult)

Afar qof ayaa tegaya barkadda.
Mina waa 7. Waxay la timid hooyadeed, waxayna leedahay koofiyad.
Jun waa 10. Wuxuu keligiis yimid, koofiyad-na ma leh.
Tom waa 6. Wuxuu la yimid walaalkiis. Walaalkiisu waa 9. Tom wuxuu leeyahay koofiyad.
Sue waa 11. Waxay barkadda ku socotaa keligeed, waxayna leedahay koofiyad.
x-e-e1-01.thinking.0: Ku dabaq xeerarka qof kasta gooni ah
x-e-e1-01.thinking.2: U sheeg qof Ingiriis, adigoo bixinaya caddayn
x-e-e1-01.prereq.1: Magac-bedelayaasha fudud sida I, you, he, she
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro qof kasta oo jebiya xeerarka ogeysiiska.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Samee jadwal leh da'da qof kasta, yaa la yimid, iyo koofiyadda, mid-mid.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hel macluumaadka xeer kasta ay la lammaanayso, oo ku xidh xariiqyo.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.a: Hubi haddii aad waafajisay da'da Mina iyo yaa la timid xeerka 3.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.c: Ka fikir haddii qofka la yimid Tom uu yahay isla qofka xeerku ka hadlayo.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.r.d: Waafaji da'da Sue iyo sida ay u socoto xeerarka 1 iyo 3 si gooni ah.
x-e-e1-01.s.s1.explain: Jun koofiyad ma leh, sidaas darteed wuxuu jebiyaa xeerka 2. Tom wuu ka yar yahay 8, laakiin walaalkii la yimid waa 9, sidaas darteed ma aha 'grown-up', Tom-na wuxuu jebiyaa xeerka 3. Mina waxay la timid hooyadeed, Sue-na waa 11, sidaas darteed way fiican tahay inay keligeed socoto oo timaaddo.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.prompt: U sheeg walaalka Tom hal ama laba weedh Ingiriis ah. Ku xidh xeerka sababta Tom u geli karin barkadda hadda.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore barbar dhig da'da Tom iyo lambarka xeerka 3.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Ku bilow 'Tom is under 8, so ...' oo qor waxa laga baahan yahay kadib.
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma ku xidhay sababta Tom u geli karin xeerka (under 8)?
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegtay sababta walaalkiis aanu u ahayn grown-up?
x-e-e1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Weedhahaaga Ingiriisku ma gaaban yihiin oo si fudud loo fahmi karaa?

x-e-e1-02.topic: Salaan gaaban, ogeysiisyo, iyo sawirro lagu sawiray erayo
x-e-e1-02.title: Saxidda sadarka khaldan ee ogeysiis lumay-iyo-la-helay oo la nuqulay
x-e-e1-02.goal: Barbar dhig ogeysiis lumay-iyo-la-helay iyo farriin saaxiib uu ka nuqulay, sadar-sadar, hel sadarka khaldan, oo si sax ah dib ugu qor.
x-e-e1-02.material:
Ogeysiis ku yaal looxa ogeysiisyada dugsiga (waxaa lagu qoray erayo oo keliya):

Lost and Found
Found: a blue water bottle, near Room 3.
Ask Ms. Park in Room 1 after school.

Saaxiibkaa Jia ayaa aragtay ogeysiiskan sababtoo ah waxay raadinaysay dhalada biyaheeda, waxayna farriin u dirtay Hana. Hana waxay rabtaa inay barbar dhigto ogeysiiska.
x-e-e1-02.thinking.0: Barbar dhig asalka iyo nuqulka sadar-sadar
x-e-e1-02.prereq.1: Akhrinta lambarrada qolalka sida Room 1, Room 3
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal sadar oo farriinta Jia ah oo ka duwan ogeysiiska.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tilmaan erayada ogeysiiska (midab, lambar qol, magaca qofka) mid-mid oo ku waafaji sadarrada farriinta.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Sadar kasta oo farriinta ah, ku waafaji sadarka ogeysiiska ee ay nuqusho, oo raadi eray aan waafaqsanayn.
x-e-e1-02.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 4 waa khalad. Ogeysiiska, Ms. Park waxay ku jirtaa Room 1, laakiin farriintu waxay leedahay Room 3, sidaas darteed waa khalad. Buluuga sadarka 2 waa isla ogeysiiska, Room 3 ee sadarka 3-na waa halka dhalada laga helay, sidaas darteed way sax tahay.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.prompt: Sax sadarka khaldan ee hadda aad heshay si uu ula mid noqdo ogeysiiska, oo Ingiriis ku qor.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.hint.0: Mar kale akhri sadarka ogeysiiska ee ku bilaabma 'Ask'.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Waxaa jira hal eray oo keliya oo laga beddelayo weedhii asalka ahayd. Hel halka eraygaas yaal.
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma ka hubisay ogeysiiska lambarka qolka Ms. Park ay ku jirto?
x-e-e1-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma kala saartay halka dhalada laga helay (Room 3) iyo halka la weydiinayo (Room 1)?

x-e-e1-03.topic: Salaan gaaban, ogeysiisyo, iyo sawirro lagu sawiray erayo
x-e-e1-03.title: Samee ogeysiis laba sadar ah oo albaabka fasalka lagu dhejiyo
x-e-e1-03.goal: Ka xukun macluumaadka (xaggee, goorma) akhristaha ogeysiisku u baahan yahay, dooro ogeysiis ku habboon, oo qor ogeysiis laba sadar ah oo adiga u gaar ah.
x-e-e1-03.material: Ardayda Fasalka 3 waxay ku jiraan qolka muusiga laga bilaabo 10:00 ilaa 11:00 maanta. Waxay rabaan inay ogeysiis ku dhejiyaan albaabka fasalka. Booqde imanaya fasalka Fasalka 3 10:30 ayaa akhrin doona ogeysiiskan.
x-e-e1-03.thinking.0: Ka fikir macluumaadka akhristuhu u baahan yahay
x-e-e1-03.thinking.2: Samee ogeysiis Ingiriis ah oo adiga u gaar ah
x-e-e1-03.prereq.0: Erayada fudud sida music room, today
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.prompt: Dooro ogeysiiska u ogolaanaya booqde imanaya 10:30 inuu ogaado labadaba 'halka uu tago' iyo 'inta uu sugi doono'.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore qor laba su'aalood oo booqde rabo inuu weydiiyo.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Mid-mid calaamadee haddii ogeysiis kasta uu ka jawaabayo labadaas su'aalood.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.r.b: Ka fikir haddii aad ogaan karto inta 'later' dhererkeedu yahay.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.r.c: Hubi haddii ogeysiiskani sheegayo labadaba waxa booqdaha rabo inuu ogaado.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.r.d: Hubi haddii uu leeyahay waqti bilow oo keliya, mise sidoo kale waqti dhammaad.
x-e-e1-03.s.s1.explain: c wuxuu sheegayaa labadaba goobta (music room) iyo waqtiga dhammaadka (11:00). Gudaha a goobta way maqan tahay, gudaha b inta waqtiga way maqan tahay, gudaha d-na waqtiga dhammaadka way maqan yahay.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.prompt: Qor ogeysiis Ingiriis ah, laba sadar, oo albaabka fasalka Fasalka 3 lagu dhejiyo. Waa inuu ka kooban yahay goobta iyo ilaa waqtiga.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore u qor hal eray mid kasta xaggee, goorma, iyo yaa.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.hint.1: Sadarka koowaad ku qor 'xaggee' sadarka labaadna 'goorma', kadibna dib u eeg.
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Qof ag marayaa ma akhrin karaa oo ogaan karaa xaggee, iyo ilaa waqtiga?
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma geliyay macluumaadka loo baahan yahay oo keliya laba sadarka?
x-e-e1-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma dooratay macluumaad dheeraad ah oo aad rabto inaad ku darto (tusaale ahaan, Class 3, Please wait)? (Ikhtiyaar)

x-e-e1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma geliyay macluumaadka loo baahan yahay oo keliya laba sadarka?
x-e-e1-10.topic: Macluumaad maqan oo fariin laba xariiq ah
x-e-e1-10.title: Dhammaystir fariinta 'I'll be late' si Hooyo aysan walwal u gelin
x-e-e1-10.goal: Hel macluumaadka ka maqan fariin hal xariiq ah oo naftaada u qor fariin laba xariiq ah oo u sheegta Hooyo si aysan walwal u gelin.
x-e-e1-10.material: Dugsiga kadib, waxaad tagi doontaa naadiga muusiga oo waxaa dhici karta inaad gurigaaga gaarto goor dambe. Waxaad rabtaa inaad Hooyo u dirto fariin qoraal ah. Waxa Hooyo ogaanayso rabto waa '2 goorma ayaad guriga imaanayso' iyo 'meeshee joogtaa iyo maxaad sameynaysaa.'
x-e-e1-10.thinking.0: Ka fikir waxa qofka helaya uu la yaabo
x-e-e1-10.thinking.2: Naftaada u qor fariin laba xariiq ah
x-e-e1-10.prereq.0: Weedho sida I'll be home at 5.
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.prompt: Fariinta kee ayaa labada wax sheegaysa si Hooyo u dareento xasillooni?
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Qor labada su'aalood ee Hooyo oo calaamadee haddii fariin kasta ay ka jawaabayso.
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.hint.1: Kala sooc haddii 'late' ama 'don't worry' ay yihiin macluumaad mise erayo kaliya oo dareenka dejiya.
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.r.b: Hubi mid mid haddii ay ka jawaabayso labada wax ee Hooyo la yaabto.
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.r.c: Hubi haddii ay leedahay macluumaadka 'goorma ayaad imaanaysaa'.
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.r.d: Hubi haddii ay leedahay 'meeshee iyo maxaad sameynaysaa'.
x-e-e1-10.s.s1.explain: b wuxuu sheegayaa labadaba waqtiga aad guriga imaanayso (5 o'clock) iyo meesha aad joogto iyo waxa aad sameynayso (naadiga muusiga). Kuwa kale waxay ka maqan yihiin mid ka mid ah labada.
x-e-e1-10.s.s2.prompt: U qor Hooyo fariin laba xariiq ah Ingiriisi. Waa inay ka kooban tahay waqtiga aad guriga imaanayso iyo meesha (ama sababta) aad goor dambe ku imaanayso. Waqtiga si xor ah ayaad u dooran kartaa.
x-e-e1-10.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore Kuuriyaan ku qor labada wax ee Hooyo doonayso inay weydiiso.
x-e-e1-10.s.s2.hint.1: Xariiqda koowaad u qor erayada ku saabsan goor dambe iyo sababta, xariiqda labaadna waqtiga imaanshaha.
x-e-e1-10.s.s2.placeholder:
Tusaale: Mom, I'll be late today.
I'm at ... and I'll be home at ...
x-e-e1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Hooyo ma ogaan kartaa waqtiga aad imaanayso?
x-e-e1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma ogaan kartaa meesha aad joogto iyo waxa aad sameyneyso (sababta aad goor dambe u tahay)?

x-e-e1-04.title: Yaa hadlaya? Beddelidda fikirkaaga marka tilmaamuhu kordhaan
x-e-e1-04.topic: Tilmaamo ku saabsan yaa, maxay, iyo xaggee
x-e-e1-04.goal: Mar kasta oo sadar hadal ah ku daro tilmaan, mar kale ka xukun yaa hadlaya, oo sharax tilmaanta go'aaminaysa Ingiriis.
x-e-e1-04.material: Waxaad arki doontaa sadarrada uu qof yidhaahdo, hal sadar mar kasta. Raac tilmaamaha oo ka fikir yaa hadlaya.
x-e-e1-04.thinking.0: Dayo dhowr suurtagalnimo oo furan hal tilmaan
x-e-e1-04.thinking.1: Dib u eeg xukunkaaga tilmaan cusub
x-e-e1-04.prereq.0: Erayada fudun sida book, card, week
x-e-e1-04.prereq.1: Salaamaha sida Welcome, Can I help you?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.prompt: Sadarradu waxay soo baxaan mid-mid. Mar kasta, dooro dhammaan dadka laga yaabo inay yihiin hadlaha.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.hint.0: Dadka aad ku reebtay tallaabadii hore, mar kale hubi haddii ay ku habboon yihiin sadarka cusub oo keliya.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.hint.1: Sadarka cusub, hel erayada magacaabaya 'shay' ama 'muddo waqti'.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Adigoo eegaya sadarkan oo keliya, yaa noqon kara hadlaha?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Sadarka koowaad oo keliya, dhowr qof ayaa suurtagal ah, sida shaqaalaha dukaanka ama maktabadle.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Dadka dukaamada ku jira sidoo kale waxay bixiyaan salaankan.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka fikir haddii salaankan inta badan lagu isticmaalo baska.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Dadka maktabadaha ku jira sidoo kale waxay weydiistaan erayo caawimo.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Dadka dukaamada iibiya buugaagta sidoo kale waxay bixiyaan isla salaanka.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Marka labada sadar la wada geliyo, yaa suurtagal ah?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Buugaag ayaa soo baxay, sidaas darteed shaqaalaha dukaanka dharka iyo darawalka baska way baxeen. Maktabadle iyo shaqaalaha dukaanka buugaagta ayaa hadha.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka fikir haddii ay ku habboon tahay in buugaag soo baxeen.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka fikir haddii ay ku xidhan tahay buugaagta.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wuxuu noqon karaa qof goob buugaag leh joogo.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wuxuu noqon karaa qof dukaan buugaag leh joogo.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Marka saddexda sadar la wada geliyo, yaa ugu habboon?
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Maadaama hadlaha uu weydiisto kaar oo uu yidhi waad haysan kartaa buugga laba usbuuc, waxay u badan tahay maktabadle amaahiya buugaag. Dukaanka buugaagta, marka aad iibsato buug caadi ahaan muddo ma jirto.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hubi haddii ay ku habboon tahay tilmaanta cusub.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hubi haddii ay ku habboon tahay tilmaanta cusub.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka fikir waxa 'two weeks' iyo 'card' macnaheedu noqon lahaa dukaanka buugaagta.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka fikir waxa erayada card iyo two weeks sameeyaan.
x-e-e1-04.s.s1.reflect: Haddii aad ku go'aamisay hal qof sadarka koowaad oo keliya, dib u eeg sida fikirkaagu u beddelmay marka tilmaamo cusub soo baxeen. Suurtagalnimooyinku waxay yaraadeen tilmaan kasta.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.prompt: Qor Ingiriis hal tilmaan sadarka ugu dambeeya oo kuu keenaya inaad u malayso 'librarian' halkii 'bookshop clerk'.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Sadarka ugu dambeeya, hel eray si kala duwan loogu isticmaali lahaa dukaanka buugaagta iyo maktabadda.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.hint.1: Qor hal weedh qaabka: '__ means ~, so ...'.
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegtay in tilmaanta aad doortay runtii kala saarto dukaanka buugaagta iyo maktabadda?
x-e-e1-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sharaxday waxa 'card' ama 'two weeks' sameeyaan?

x-e-e1-05.topic: Tilmaamo ku saabsan yaa, maxay, iyo xaggee
x-e-e1-05.title: Cinema mise saldhigga tareenka? Barbar dhigidda xoogga tilmaamaha
x-e-e1-05.goal: Barbar dhig sida tilmaamaha wada-hadalka ay xooggan u go'aamiyaan goobta, oo Ingiriis ku sharax sababta tilmaamaha daciifka ah keligood aysan ugu filnayn.
x-e-e1-05.material:
Laba qof ayaa sidan u wada hadlaya.
A: Two tickets, please.
B: Which film?
A: The 3 o'clock one.
B: Row F or Row G?
A: Row F, please.

(Row = safka kuraasta, film = shaashad)

Saaxiibkaa Yuna wuxuu leeyahay, "Tickets! It's a train station." Saaxiibkaa Min wuxuu leeyahay, "It's a cinema (a movie theater)."
x-e-e1-05.thinking.1: Ogow in hal tilmaan ay ku habboon tahay dhowr goob
x-e-e1-05.prereq.0: Erayada fudud sida ticket, film, seat
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.prompt: Dooro dhammaan tilmaamaha ugu xooggan taageera bayaanka Min ('cinema').
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tilmaan kasta ku tijaabi 'Ma laga isticmaali karaa goobo kale sidoo kale?'
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Sawir sheegidda erayadaas isku mid ah saldhigga tareenka ama beerta xayawaanka.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.a: Ka fikir haddii cinema uu yahay goobta keliya ee tikidh u baahan.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.b: Ka fikir goobtee ayuu erayga film ka tirsan yahay.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.c: Ka fikir haddii cinema uu yahay goobta keliya ee waqtiyada lagu sheego.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.r.d: Ka fikir waxa safka iyo xarfuhu go'aamiyaan.
x-e-e1-05.s.s1.explain: Film (shaashad) iyo Row F/G (saf kuraas) waa tilmaamo xooggan oo tilmaamaya cinema. Ticket iyo 3 o'clock waa tilmaamo daciif ah oo laga isticmaali karo saldhigga tareenka, beerta xayawaanka, ama hoolka riwaayadaha.
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.prompt: Ka jawaab Yuna Ingiriis hal ama laba weedh. Qor sababta 'tickets' keligeed uusan u go'aamin karin inuu yahay saldhigga tareenka.
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir laba ama saddex goobood oo kale oo isticmaala 'ticket'.
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isku day inaad ku bilowdo qaabka 'Tickets can be for ... too.'
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma magacawday ugu yaraan hal goob kale oo tikidhada laga isticmaalo?
x-e-e1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma xustay tilmaamaha tilmaamaya cinema (film, Row)?

x-e-e1-06.topic: Tilmaamo ku saabsan yaa, maxay, iyo xaggee
x-e-e1-06.title: Shay qarsoon: maxaan weydiin doonaa xigta?
x-e-e1-06.goal: Marka dhowr musharax ay hadhaan, dooro su'aasha ugu fiican ee kala saarta musharaxiinta, oo samee su'aal Ingiriis ah oo adiga u gaar ah.
x-e-e1-06.material:
Saaxiib ayaa ka fikiraya shay. Waxaa jira laba tilmaan.
Hint 1: It is round. (It is round and roundish)
Hint 2: It is in the kitchen. (It is in the kitchen)

Waxaa jira afar musharax: apple, plate, clock, iyo cup. Waxaad rabtaa inaad hesho midka adigoo weydiinaya su'aalo haa/maya.
x-e-e1-06.prereq.0: Qaababka su'aalaha sida Is it ...? Can you ...?
x-e-e1-06.s.s1.prompt: Su'aashee ayaa ugu fiican soo koobta musharaxiinta sida su'aasha xigta?
x-e-e1-06.s.s1.hint.0: Su'aal weydiisa isla wixii tilmaan aad horay u taqaanay ma soo koobi karto musharaxiinta.
x-e-e1-06.s.s1.hint.1: Qor musharaxiinta hadha marka jawaabtu tahay 'haa' iyo marka ay tahay 'maya'.
x-e-e1-06.s.s1.r.a: Hubi haddii mid ka mid ah afarta musharax uu helayo jawaab kala duwan.
x-e-e1-06.s.s1.r.b: Hubi haddii aad hore ugu baratay Tilmaanta 1.
x-e-e1-06.s.s1.r.c: Hubi haddii aad hore ugu baratay Tilmaanta 2.
x-e-e1-06.s.s1.r.d: Ka fikir haddii jawaabtu kala qaybin lahayd afarta musharax.
x-e-e1-06.s.s1.explain: Tufaaxa oo keliya ayaa la cuni karaa; saxanka, saacadda, iyo koobka lama cuni karo. Sidaas darteed "Can you eat it?" wuxuu kala qaybiyaa musharaxiinta. "Round" iyo "kitchen" mar hore ayaa tilmaamaha laga ogaaday, "nice" wuxuu ku kala duwan yahay qof walba, sidaas darteed ma kala qaybin karo musharaxiinta.

x-e-e1-07.title: Hel oo saxo jawaabta aan ku habboonayn wada hadal dhalashada
x-e-e1-07.goal: Adigoo isticmaalaya xaaladda (dhalashada kuwa), hel jawaabta aan ku habboonayn wada hadalka, oo dooro jawaab ku habboon.
x-e-e1-07.material: Maanta waa dhalashada Ana. Ma aha dhalashada Leo. Leo wuxuu Ana siiyaa hadiyad.
x-e-e1-07.thinking.0: Isku mid ka dhig xaaladda iyo jawaabaha
x-e-e1-07.prereq.0: Ereyada Happy birthday, Thank you, You're welcome
x-e-e1-07.s.s1.prompt: Wada hadalkan, dooro xariiqda jawaabta Ana aysan ku habboonayn xaaladda.
x-e-e1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore hubi dhalashada kuwa maanta tahay, kadibna akhri jawaab kasta oo Ana ka mid ah labada jawaab oo la socda waxa Leo yidhi isla markii ka horreysay.
x-e-e1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi, hal xariiq mar, haddii xariiq kastaa loo akhrin karo falcelin dabiici ah oo xariiqda ka horreysa.
x-e-e1-07.s.s1.explain: Xariiqda 2 ma habboona. Maanta waa dhalashada Ana, ma aha ta Leo, sidaas darteed "to you too" ma habboona. Ana, oo hadiyad heshay, waa inay tiraahdo mahadsanid, kadibna waxay sidoo kale ku xirmaysaa "You're welcome." ee Leo xariiqda xigta.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.prompt: Dooro jawaabta saxda ah ee Ana xariiqda aad hadda heshay.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore erayada u beddel Kuuriyaan si aad u aragto xaalad noocee ah ayaa lagu isticmaalaa.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.hint.1: Geli doorashada xariiqda 2 oo akhri haddii ay ku xirmayso hadalka Leo ee xariiqda ugu dambeysa.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.r.a: Erayadani waxay ka jawaabaan mahadnaq. Yaa hadda mahadnaq sheegaya?
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.r.b: Hubi haddii "me too" ku habboon yahay waxa Leo yidhi.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.r.c: Ka fikir haddii kani yahay falcelin ku habboon marka la helo hadiyad.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.r.d: Ka fikir yaa waxa u sameeyey yaa daqiiqadda hadiyadda la bixiyey.
x-e-e1-07.s.s2.explain: Maadaama ay hadiyad heshay, Thank you wuu ku habboon yahay. Saxiddan, Leo "You're welcome." xariiqda xigta sidoo kale si dabiici ah ayay u raacdaa.

x-e-e1-08.title: Diidmada si kala duwan macallinka iyo saaxiibka
x-e-e1-08.goal: Isla xaaladda (aan awoodin inaad caawiso), xukun hannaanka iyo macluumaadka ku habboon macallinka iyo saaxiibka, oo mid walba ugu jawaab Ingiriisi.
x-e-e1-08.material: Fasalka kadib, macallinku wuxuu leeyahay, "Can you help me carry the books?" Laakiin ma caawin kartid sababtoo ah waa inaad tagto dhakhtarka ilkaha 3. Waa isku mid kadib haddii saaxiib uu yidhaahdo, "Can you help me carry the books?"
x-e-e1-08.thinking.0: Dooro erayo si ay qofka ugu habboonaato
x-e-e1-08.thinking.1: Isla markaa sheeg diidmada iyo sababta
x-e-e1-08.thinking.2: U beddel isla nuxurka si kale
x-e-e1-08.s.s1.prompt: Waa kee jawaabta ugu habboon macallinka?
x-e-e1-08.s.s1.hint.0: Marka hore hubi haddii erayadu ku habboon yihiin xaaladda (ballanta dhakhtarka ilkaha).
x-e-e1-08.s.s1.hint.1: Jawaab kasta, calaamadee haddii ay leedahay saddexda wax (diidmo, sabab, iyo hab) oo isbarbar dhig.
x-e-e1-08.s.s1.r.a: Hubi haddii xaqiiqooyinku ku habboon yihiin xaaladda.
x-e-e1-08.s.s1.r.b: Wuxuu leeyahay sabab, laakiin ka fikir haddii habku ku habboon yahay hadalka macallinka.
x-e-e1-08.s.s1.r.c: Waa edeb leh, laakiin hubi haddii ay ka kooban tahay sabab diidmo.
x-e-e1-08.s.s1.r.d: Hubi haddii uu diidaa oo keliya, mise uu leeyahay sabab iyo edeb labadaba.
x-e-e1-08.s.s1.explain: Macallinka, waa sax inaad tiraahdo waan ka xumahay oo aad sidoo kale bixiso sabab. a ma waafaqsana xaqiiqooyinka. b wuxuu leeyahay sabab laakiin hannaanku waa qallafsan yahay, c-na waa edeb leh laakiin sabab ma laha.
x-e-e1-08.s.s2.prompt: Macallinka ugu jawaab Ingiriisi. Waa inuu ka kooban yahay erayada sheegaya inaadan caawin karin, sababta, iyo weedh edeb leh.
x-e-e1-08.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore Kuuriyaan ku qor saddexda qaybood 'I'm sorry', 'I can't help', iyo 'I'm going to the dentist'.
x-e-e1-08.s.s2.hint.1: Saddexda qaybood nidaam ahaan ugu xir hal ama laba weedh Ingiriisi ah.
x-e-e1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Diidmada, sababta, iyo edebku dhammaantood ma jiraan?
x-e-e1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma u egtahay sida lagula hadlo macallinka?
x-e-e1-08.s.s3.prompt: Ku qor Ingiriisi jawaab gaaban oo aad siiso saaxiib weydiisanaya isla fadhi-qaadkan. Ku qor hab ka dabacsan kii aad macallinka u sheegtay, laakiin ku dar diidmada iyo sababta.
x-e-e1-08.s.s3.hint.0: Ka hay oo keliya erayada runtii loo baahan yahay ee aad macallinka u sheegtay.
x-e-e1-08.s.s3.hint.1: Isku day inaad ku bilowdo 'Sorry,' gaaban.
x-e-e1-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma ku qortay si ka dabacsan oo ka gaaban kii aad macallinka u qortay?
x-e-e1-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Diidmada iyo sababtu weli ma hadaan?

Jisu wuxuu soo diray fariin.
